premises.text: Livestock disease creates large economic and public-health risk, and outbreaks are caught too late despite heavy drug R&D spend
premises.evidence_span: we're not catching these events until it's far too late

premises.text: REX combines historic and real-time clinical data with animal and disease genomics into one standardized comprehensive view
premises.evidence_span: we bring in historic and real-time data, and then we combine it into one standard format, and finally combine this clinical information with genomics data

premises.text: Software pillars help vets diagnose at point of care and spot outbreaks, mine records for effective treatments, and help pharma find gene targets faster
premises.evidence_span: we have three pillars to our software

premises.text: A farm-level antibiotic resistance map shows which drugs remain effective for common infections
premises.evidence_span: world's first antibiotic resistance map on a farm level in the world

premises.text: Monetization is annual subscriptions plus fees for collaborative custom projects, leveraging livestock–pharma network effects
